# asc_object_storage (Data Source)

Retrieves an existing object storage from the ASC platform.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the object storage.

### Read-Only

- `endpoint` (String) Endpoint of the object storage.
- `name` (String) Name of the object storage.
- `quota` (Block, Read-only) the quota configuration for the object storage (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--quota))
- `reclaim_policy` (String) Reclaim policy of the object storage.
- `region` (String) Region of the object storage.
- `tags` (Attributes List) Tags applied to the database instance. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `tenant_id` (String) Identifier of the tenant that owns the object storage.

<a id="nestedblock--quota"></a>
### Nested Schema for `quota`

Read-Only:

- `max_size` (String) the max size of the object storage


<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) Tag key.
- `value` (String) Tag value.
